subject: Roadmap demo consolidation & exec anchor swap — Renewal QBR
body:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@mcmc.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Victor Huang <victor.huang@mcmc.com>, procurement@mcmc.com
Date: Sun, 01 Dec 2029 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal QBR — consolidating roadmap demo + exec time

Hi Markus —

Thanks again for the briefing last month. We’re working to consolidate the Renewal QBR (Dec 10th week) and want to combine the technical roadmap demo and the exec-facing summary into one 60–75 minute slot instead of two separate sessions. Our exec team is tight on calendar; we need an "anchor" 45-minute window for the execs and then a 30-minute hands-on breakout for engineering.

Ask: can Redwood compress the demo flow and provide an exec-friendly 45-minute anchor that includes the top three platform changes (dedicated, private, Optimize batch/quantization profiles) and a short procurement checklist?

Attendees: Elaine Park (CS sponsor), Victor Huang (IT lead), Procurement Team (procurement@mcmc.com).

Constraints:
- Execs available Dec 11–13, 10:00–13:00 PT only
- Engineering prefers Dec 12–14, 08:00–12:00 PT
- Recording required for on-demand playback

Can you propose a compact agenda and an anchor time we can hold? Also flag any procurement artifacts we should prepare beforehand (SLA exceptions, PO cadence).

Best,
Elaine Park
Customer Success Manager
MCMC Health

-----Original internal note-----
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 01 Dec 2029 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal QBR — consolidating roadmap demo + exec time

Marissa / Priyom — forwarding Elaine's note. MCMC wants to compress exec + tech into a single consolidated session (exec anchor + breakout). Their exec window is narrow (10–13 PT). Can we do the following:

Proposed:
- Dec 12, 10:30–11:15 PT — Exec anchor (45 min) led by Markus + Laura for SLAs and roadmap summary
- Dec 12, 11:20–11:50 PT — Engineering breakout (30 min) led by Marissa + Priyom for deep dive and ops Q&A

Operational asks:
- Recording & short summary deck for execs (5 slides)
- Share a one-page procurement checklist (PO cadence, billing contact, SLA exception process)
- Migrate mutual-action-plan into spreadsheet and send prior to meeting

Marissa — can you own the tech breakout? Priyom — can you prep procurement checklist and confirm whether we need a separate legal/finance pre-call? Laura — can you do the exec summary slides?

Markus
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

-----Original message from Marissa Cole to external (reply)-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@mcmc.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Dec 2029 09:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — consolidating roadmap demo + exec time

Hi Elaine —

Thanks for the clear constraints — we can absolutely do a compact format that keeps the execs focused and gives your engineers the deep dive they need.

I proposed the schedule below so we have a clean handoff and a short buffer to load shared artifacts:
- 10:30–11:10 PT — Exec anchor (40 min) — Markus will open with business highlights and Laura will cover SLA/enterprise controls (15 minutes).
- 11:10–11:15 PT — 5 min quick break / tech handover
- 11:15–11:45 PT — Engineering breakout (30 min) — demo of Dedicated + private deployment patterns and Optimize recommendations.

I’ve attached a mutual action plan (stub) and a short roadmap PDF for you to review.

Attachments: MCMC_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_20291202.xlsx (mutual action plan — skeleton), Redwood_Roadmap_Slate_v3.pdf (short deck)

Two quick questions:
1) Exec recording — do you need the full breakout recorded or just the exec anchor? We can record both but some customers prefer exec-only to avoid ops noise.
2) Procurement — do you want the PO/contact details in the mutual action plan or as a separate procurement checklist?

If the time works, I’ll send a calendar hold and we’ll route a short runbook to your team the day before.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

-----Original: Markus Klein to Elaine (final confirm)-----
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@mcmc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, procurement@mcmc.com
Date: Tue, 03 Dec 2029 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal QBR — consolidating roadmap demo + exec time

Elaine —

Thanks — 10:30–11:45 PT on Dec 12 is reserved on our side (exec anchor + tech breakout). We will:
- Deliver a 5-slide exec summary + 40 min talk track (Markus/Laura)
- Hand off to Marissa/Priyom for 30 min tech deep dive (11:15–11:45)
- Record both sessions; we will label the recording to make the exec segment easy to find
- Share the Mutual Action Plan and procurement checklist by EOD Dec 3

Priyom, please confirm whether Procurement needs a DocuSign skeleton before the meeting or if a PO commitment after the meeting is acceptable.

Elaine — if that works, Marissa will send a calendar invite and a short runbook (one page) with dial-in, recording consent, and slide deck link.

Appreciate the flexibility — looking forward to a tight, actionable session.

Best,
Markus Klein
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

--

Redwood Inference
